response.sql: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '') AS batting_hand, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM player_award AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '')), totals AS (SELECT SUM(award_count) AS total_awards, COUNT(*) AS hand_count FROM hand_counts) SELECT h.batting_hand, h.award_count, h.award_count * 1.0 / t.total_awards AS share, h.award_count * 1.0 / t.total_awards - 1.0 / t.hand_count AS above_average FROM hand_counts AS h CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE h.award_count * 1.0 / t.total_awards > 1.0 / t.hand_count;
